day_shape: 82 items: OFAC publishes Iran GLs AA/BB and an E.O. 13902 sector determination, IDF strikes Nabatieh after two Hezbollah drones and kills a Hamas commander in Khan Younis, Qatar's PM meets Pezeshkian, Qalibaf and Rezaei in Tehran, CENTCOM logs 75 vessels redirected under the Iran blockade, and Iran's statistics centre reports 89% year-on-year inflation.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade, OFAC actions, back-channels
threads.summary: OFAC published Iran-related General Licenses AA and BB and a sector determination under E.O. 13902, while CENTCOM said its forces have redirected 75 commercial vessels, disabled 3 and boarded 2 enforcing the Iran blockade. Iran International reported continuing Iran–Oman talks on the Strait of Hormuz with Pakistani and Qatari involvement; Defa Press cited Oil Minister Paknejad saying crude deliveries continue, and Trump said he was in no hurry to resume talks.

threads.label: Qatari PM's Tehran visit
threads.summary: Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani met President Pezeshkian, Parliament Speaker Qalibaf and SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei in Tehran. IRIB quoted Rezaei warning the US of "a calamity recorded in history" if it commits aggression; Defa Press said Qalibaf raised US breaches of the Islamabad Memorandum which Qatar helped mediate.

threads.label: Hezbollah drones and IDF Nabatieh strikes
threads.summary: The IDF said Hezbollah launched two explosive drones overnight at troops on the Ali-Taher Ridge inside its southern Lebanon security zone, downing one and losing contact with the second with no injuries. Israel then struck Hezbollah weapons-storage sites in the Nabatieh area; Lebanon's Health Ministry reported one killed and six wounded in Arab Salim, per IRIB and Defa Press.

threads.label: Gaza strikes, ceasefire disputes, Erez
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas commander Ismail Mohammed Ibrahim Barim in Khan Younis — who it said had held hostages Edan Alexander, Matan Zangauker and Avera Mengistu — and also struck two Nukhba operatives who took part in the October 7 attack. Netanyahu and Katz said there was "no instruction" to open Erez Crossing on 1 September before Hamas is disarmed, while the UN Security Council heard Gaza was at "an absolute breaking point."

threads.label: European roles in Gaza coordination centre
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post and Financial Times reported Israel is considering expelling British and possibly other European officials from the US-led post-war Gaza coordination centre in Kiryat Gat, though an Israeli official denied a specific claim about German and Italian representatives. Separately, US authorities recommended disbarring three former UNRWA staff over alleged Hamas and PIJ ties and involvement in the October 7 attack.

threads.label: Iranian domestic repression and extraterritorial activity
threads.summary: Iran International reported a Shahin Shahr court sentenced Leila Abolhassani to death for "waging war against God," and HRANA said two more January protesters received death sentences. Canadian documents cited by Global News described a former senior Iranian official in Toronto as "critical" to revenue funding Iran's military; Newsmax reported Yair Netanyahu was an Iranian assassination target in Florida.

threads.label: Iran economic messaging
threads.summary: Iran's Statistics Centre reported the consumer price index rose 3.4% month-on-month and 89% year-on-year for Mordad 1405, while Central Bank Governor Hameti claimed the country had "moved beyond hyperinflation" to relative stability. The Central Bank's currency deputy said $17bn had been allocated this year and the allocation-to-provision interval had been cut to two weeks.

events.summary_en: Possibility of obtaining interest-free loans for marriage and childbearing through welfare card becomes available. According to an announcement by the Central Bank, if applicants for interest-free loan facilities for marriage and childbearing receive a welfare card linked to Gam bonds, they will be prioritised for receiving the loan. Banks are also obliged, upon the applicant's request in the system, to proceed with issuing a welfare card for applicants of this type of facility in the shortest possible time, and applicants will not remain waiting in the queue for the loan. The conditions of the interest-free loan facilities do not change in this method, but applicants can, instead of receiving cash, proceed through the welfare card to purchase goods and household items.
